description: Governars Secretariat - Sabaragamuwa - Provincial Council Act.No 42 of 1975 Sixth Supplementary Financial Statement - 2024.
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with government structural and administrative changes related to provincial council financial management. It grants permission for expenditure disbursement, amends financial statements, and outlines budget allocations to various provincial government departments and programs. No specific individuals are named (only generic titles like "Chief Secretary"), and it focuses solely on administrative functions and financial restructuring of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council without detailing personnel appointments or individual responsibilities.
